name: research-tools
description: Research skills and MCP servers for PaperRead drafts and reviews, private paper-review assignment sync, paper-library intake, Zotero-linked Todoist reading tasks, public paper search, clean web-page extraction, local document extraction, and source-backed Research and Docmost Lab Wikis.

interface.description: Create and review PaperRead notes, synchronize private review assignments, manage paper intake and linked reading tasks, and maintain source-backed Research and Lab Wikis.
interface.shortDescription: PaperRead, review sync, paper intake, Todoist reading, documents, and Research/Lab Wiki tools.
interface.longDescription: Research Tools packages lightweight PaperRead draft and source-backed review workflows for Obsidian notes, confidential Docmost-to-Zotero-to-Todoist paper-review reconciliation, Zotero-first public paper-library intake, Zotero-linked Todoist reading-task planning, paper-search MCP, Zotero MCP, Defuddle web extraction, quality-first local MinerU document extraction, the existing Research LLM Wiki, and a separate read-only Docmost-to-Obsidian Lab Wiki with offline hybrid search.
defaultPrompt: Extract a complex local document with checksum-verified MinerU outputs.
Use $research-llm-wiki or $docmost-lab-wiki for source-backed Obsidian wiki workflows.
